europe_now.title: France Security Response and Curfews
europe_now.summary: France has implemented local curfews and initiated immediate trials for individuals involved in city-center disturbances following widespread protests. Prime Minister Lecornu has engaged with trade unions and announced plans for a significant police deployment ahead of further demonstrations.

sources.headline: Live: French PM Lecornu to meet with unions ahead of new protests
Hundreds put on immediate trial for ransacking city centres across France

europe_now.title: Italy Security Measures Following Milan Clashes
europe_now.summary: The Italian government has introduced heightened security legislation and deployed 500 soldiers in response to recent rioting and clashes in Milan. These measures aim to restore public order and address escalating civil unrest in major urban areas.

sources.headline: Italy announces new security measures after Milan riots, deploying 500 soldiers
Italy sends troops, toughens security laws after Milan clashes

top_stories.title: Poland Abortion Law Reform
top_stories.summary: The Polish parliament has voted to ease abortion regulations in a direct challenge to the nation's conservative president. This legislative move marks a significant shift in the country's social policy.

sources.headline: Poland’s government votes to ease abortion laws in challenge to conservative president

top_stories.title: Ukraine Defense Diplomacy in Norway
top_stories.summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky held discussions with U.S. representatives in Oslo regarding intelligence sharing and defense coordination. Meanwhile, the European Union is urging international partners such as Canada and the UK to increase financial support for Ukraine.
